**Revision apps:**

These local interactive tools support internal exploration of revision results.

+ [Open the FASH trajectory explorer](http://127.0.0.1:7421/) — two tabs over all 1,009,173 tested pairs. **Trajectory explorer:** search any gene-variant pair and compare observed estimates, IWP1 FASH, predictive-SD mixture FASH-linear, an optional Strober-style weighted trend, and matched Strober statistics. **All-pair browser:** sort and filter the full result table by per-method significance, optionally keep only each gene's most significant variant, read live counts and co-significance for the current view, and click any row to plot it. Filtering and thinning are display operations; significance always reflects the full-data FDR-0.05 calls.

The link above only resolves while the app is running, since a static page cannot start an R process. Run the launcher from the workflowr project root; it reuses an already-running instance, otherwise starts one and waits until it answers, then opens the browser:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
./apps/fash_trajectory_explorer/run_explorer.sh
```

`run_explorer.sh status`, `stop`, `restart`, and `log` are also available. Cold start takes about 20 seconds while the retained IWP1 fit loads.
